context.task_description:
Elicit and document project requirements. Produce a structured folder of
requirements: one file per FR, one file per NFR, with Gherkin acceptance
criteria embedded in each file, and index files at each folder level.
After stakeholder HIL sign-off, produce a requirements lock file that
captures a stable snapshot for downstream drift detection.

notes: Owner-story T1 gate resolved autonomously under the standing workstream-autonomy grant (loggable default). Story source: owner request 2026-10-12 verbatim in the scaffold brief — LINK dedupe, PHOTO unification with app-local fallback, multiple indexed NICKNAMES (store-as-entered). Feasibility fallbacks pre-authorized by the owner in the request. T2 final-sign-off + DV-1..6 remain the owner checkpoints.
